judgmentCalls: 2611.01158v1 belongs only in Exothermic DM because the excited scalar's mass splitting supplies the recoil energy through down-scattering.

Its contribution is candidate rather than candidate-and-bound: the paper proposes the LZ explanation and applies existing gamma-ray, CMB, and dwarf-galaxy constraints without centrally deriving an independent new empirical limit.
The new record received semantic coordinate (80.8, 68.6) near established exothermic Higgs-portal papers and contiguous layout rank 140; no established coordinate or rank changed.
2610.13930v2 remains Electroweak inelastic DM with candidate contribution because its central MRSSM pseudo-Dirac transition mechanism is unchanged from v1.

2611.00306v1 was excluded because the LZ sentence is speculative support for a DAMA-focused scenario rather than a substantial interpretation, calculation, constraint, or diagnostic of the isolated 248 keV recoil.
Citation edges were copied only from complete exact-version arXiv HTML bibliographies; no edge was inferred from prose, dates, or conceptual proximity.
